email.body1:
Saw Momentum.io shipped SmartClips and Account Briefs, doubling down on agentic AI for revenue teams. As the founding RevOps lead, you are likely the one wiring those signals into rep execution.

Most RevOps teams have more in-market accounts than reps can touch, and can't hire SDRs fast enough to cover them. An autonomous worker turns signals into researched, CRM-logged outreach, so coverage scales without new headcount, 3-5x meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Momentum.io off your hiring and tech-stack signals, accounts like these tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Following up on Momentum.io's push into agentic deal execution. The same gap shows up in pipeline gen: signals pile up faster than reps can research, write, and log outreach against them.

Where that signal-to-action latency gets fixed, reps stop burning hours on enrichment and CRM hygiene and spend it in meetings instead. Tighter, personalized emails alone lift response rates 50-70% in our data.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and the 3 changes I'd make first.
email.body3:
Still think there's a clean fit here for Momentum.io as you scale coverage. Wanted to share one data point.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs realistically. With an autonomous worker, they booked $2.7M in qualified pipeline and 60 BANT deals in 90 days, same team, all auto-logged to CRM.

Want to grab time so I can walk you through how Momentum.io's reply rate compares to other startups at your stage? Quick 15 minutes.
email.body4:
I have not heard back, so I will assume scaling outbound coverage is not a priority for Momentum.io this quarter.

Before I close your file, the offer stands: an autonomous worker that turns signals into researched, logged outreach so your team covers every in-market account without adding SDRs.

Worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of 3 AI-SDR plays for your motion? If now is not the time, just say the word and I will step back.
